entry_rule: First common-eligible E056 v2 entry_intent per UTC date. Shared initial quantity is sized at stress cost. Missing days remain missing. No outcome-based replacement.
zone_rule: Existing multiscale executed-volume profiles; full 15m buckets plus 1m delay. Freeze entry support and nearest profitable opposing zone for each episode; no new zone search during episode.
stop_rule: Support adverse boundary plus max(2 ticks,0.10 preceding ATR). Common hard stop and the recovery engine's tighter lot stops. Existing completed hourly double-close invalidation is additional context.
split_rule: Two adverse prices at 75% and 25% of the support width (short mirrored); each at most 0.25B risk and 0.25 of total initial capacity. Explicit 15m expiry, no fill before later minute open.
execution_rule: Quotes are minute-open proxies plus adverse spread/slippage, not historical bid/ask. Capacity uses only previous completed minute volume. Never fill from a bar touch. Ambiguous stop/entry bars cancel increases; no order backdating. Funding applies to holdings strictly before its timestamp.
episode_rule: Independent equal-capital diagnostic episodes; may overlap, never summed into one portfolio. Up to72h, right-censor open positions and estimate net liquidation equity; do not force time exits. No re-entry after an episode settles.
limitations: No historical orderbook or verified queue position
Frozen support/target and imported entry model do not prove the full discretionary strategy
No production liquidation or exchange margin simulation
